name: Banter Mart
tagline: A marketplace where verified humans swipe on products and their agents negotiate the price, with final approval by people.

awards: World U: Build for the future of the internet with World

problem: Online marketplaces are full of bots and haggling is slow.
solution: A World mini app: buyers swipe right, human-backed agents negotiate using anchors and market comparisons, and both sides approve or decline the proposed deal in one click.
demo_moment: Team-described: swipe on an item and watch two agents settle on a price.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “World U: Build for the future of the internet with World” among 307 submissions.
No money moves without an explicit human decision.

lessons: Let agents haggle, but keep the approval click human.
